normativ: 8 bosqich tartib bilan, signal so'zlar bilan

kahoot.q: Section 4 has no pause in the middle. When should you read all ten questions?
kahoot.explain: Section 4 da oraliq tanaffus yo'q — 10 savolning hammasini boshidagi tayyorlanish vaqtida ko'rib chiqing.

kahoot.q: 'Each member receives a ___ at the first meeting.' What kind of word fits the gap?
kahoot.explain: "a" artikli — birlikdagi sanaladigan ot belgisi.

kahoot.q: ONE WORD ONLY. Gap: 'Bring a ___ to every lecture.' You hear 'a small notebook'. What do you write?
kahoot.explain: "a" gapda bor, "small" esa ortiqcha — ONE WORD ONLY da faqat "notebook" yoziladi.

kahoot.q: ONE OR TWO WORDS. Which answer stays within the word limit?
kahoot.explain: Chiziqcha bilan yozilgan so'z (part-time) bitta so'z sanaladi; artikl ham so'z, qo'shilsa 3 so'z bo'ladi.

kahoot.q: In a flow-chart task, the speaker says 'Once that's done, ...'. What does this usually signal?
options: The talk is about to end
kahoot.explain: "Once that's done" — oldingi bosqich tugadi, keyingi qutiga o'ting.

kahoot.q: Flow chart, boxes 6–10: box 8 is still empty, but you hear 'Finally, ...'. What is the best thing to do?
options: Move on to the last box
Wait for box 8 to be repeated
Write the next word you hear in 8
kahoot.explain: Audio qaytarilmaydi: oxirgi qutiga o'ting, bo'sh qolgan 8 ga oxirida taxminiy javob yozing.

kahoot.q: Are flow-chart answers usually heard in the same order as the boxes?
options: Yes, in the order of the boxes
kahoot.explain: Flow chart jarayon tartibida tuziladi — audio ham shu tartibda boradi.

kahoot.q: Gap: 'The festival was funded by ___.' Which words in a talk are most likely to lead to the answer?
kahoot.explain: "was funded by" = "the money came from" — ma'no bir xil, so'zlar boshqa.

kahoot.q: Gap: 'Members get a free ___ every month.' You hear: 'Members get free tickets, and a free magazine every month.' What do you write?
kahoot.explain: "a free ___ every month" — birlikdagi ot va "every month": magazine; "tickets" — tuzoq.

kahoot.q: In Section 4, can a question test the speaker's opinion, not just a fact?
options: Only in the first half of the talk
kahoot.explain: Section 4 da ma'ruzachining fikri va maslahati ham savol bo'lishi mumkin ("I think...", "I'd recommend...").

kahoot.q: You hear 'Collect your certificates at the front desk.' Gap: 'Collect your ___ at the front desk.' You write 'certificate'. Is it correct?
options: Yes — the meaning is the same
No — it must start with a capital
kahoot.explain: Eshitilgan shakl ko'plikda — "-s" tushib qolsa, javob noto'g'ri.

kahoot.q: You write 'color' instead of the British spelling 'colour'. How is it marked?
options: Wrong — only British spelling is accepted
Correct, but it loses half a mark
Wrong — it is a spelling mistake
kahoot.explain: IELTS'da Britaniya va Amerika imlosi ikkalasi ham qabul qilinadi; faqat imlo xatosi 0 ball.

kahoot.q: 'News reports must be accurate.' What does 'accurate' mean?
kahoot.explain: accurate — aniq, xatosiz: hamma tafsiloti to'g'ri.

kahoot.q: 'Anyone can contribute ideas to the class blog.' Which verb is closest in meaning to 'contribute'?
kahoot.explain: contribute — hissa qo'shmoq: o'z fikri yoki g'oyasini qo'shmoq.

kahoot.q: A profitable blog is one that ...
options: makes more money than it costs
kahoot.explain: profitable — foyda keltiradigan: daromadi xarajatidan ko'p.

kahoot.q: The posts appear in chronological order. How are they arranged?
kahoot.explain: chronological — vaqt tartibida: avval eng eskisi, keyin yangilari.

kahoot.q: Complete: 'Short paragraphs help to ___ the reader's interest.'
kahoot.explain: hold someone's interest — qiziqishini ushlab turmoq: o'quvchi o'qishni to'xtatmaydi.

kahoot.q: 'Make a study plan and stick to it.' What does 'stick to it' mean?
kahoot.explain: stick to (a plan/schedule) — rejaga qat'iy amal qilmoq, uni o'zgartirmaslik.

kahoot.q: 'This guidebook is bang up to date.' What does this mean?
options: It was written a long time ago
It is full of spelling mistakes
It is too heavy to carry
kahoot.explain: bang up to date — eng so'nggi ma'lumotga ega, mutlaqo zamonaviy.

kahoot.sub: the right place at the right time
kahoot.q: 'She was in the right place at the right time.' What does this suggest?
options: She was lucky to be there
kahoot.explain: be in the right place at the right time — omad: kerakli payt kerakli joyda bo'lish.

lessons.title: Mock test 1: Unit 1–4 dan keyin — natijalar tahlili (imtihon alohida 150 daqiqalik sessiyada)
lessons.grammar_topic: Mockdan keyingi tahlil darsi: imtihonning o'zi dars sonidan tashqaridagi alohida 150 daqiqalik sessiyada (JonyOS → Imtihonlar → Mock testlar, qat'iy rejim, faqat kompyuter; Listening ~30, Reading 60, Writing 60 daqiqa); bu darsda natija savol turlari bo'yicha Unit 1–4 ga bog'lab tahlil qilinadi, Writing AI izohi 4 mezon bo'yicha ko'rib chiqiladi va ikki haftalik reja yoziladi
lessons.vocab_topic: Xom ball va band, yetti xato sababi, savol turi bo'yicha naqsh, unitga qaytish, Writing mezonlari, ikki haftalik reja
lessons.book_ref: JonyOS mock bazasi: JonyOS → Imtihonlar → Mock testlar (qat'iy rejim, faqat kompyuter). Mock — dars sonidan tashqaridagi alohida 150 daqiqalik sessiya: Listening ~30, Reading 60, Writing 60 daqiqa; Listening yozuvi bo'lmasa, skriptni examiner ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi. Examiner javoblar varaqasi har savol bo'yicha o'quvchining javobi, to'g'ri javob va mavzu belgisini ko'rsatadi; Listening va Reading bandi rasmiy xom ball — band jadvali bo'yicha avtomatik qo'yiladi. Writing'ni JonyOS AI examiner 4 IELTS mezoni bo'yicha baholaydi; examiner 48 soat ichida tekshiradi yoki o'zgartiradi, keyin natija e'lon qilinadi.
objectives: Mock sessiyasini tartib bilan o'tkazish (alohida kun, JonyOS → Imtihonlar → Mock testlar, qat'iy rejim): xona va ekran tayyorligi, qoidalar, Listening, tugatgan o'quvchi bilan ishlash.
Mock (Listening ~30 + Reading 60 + Writing 60 = 150 daqiqa) dars sonidan tashqaridagi alohida sessiya ekanini, bu 120 daqiqalik dars esa faqat natijalar tahlili ekanini bilish.
O'z natijasini o'qish: xom ball, band va qaysi bo'lim o'rtachani pastga tortgani.
Har xato javobni yetti sababdan bittasiga ajratish.
Xatolarni savol turi bo'yicha guruhlab, Unit 1–4 dagi qaysi darsga qaytish kerakligini aniqlash.
Maqsad bilan solishtirish (kamida 5.5: Listening 18+, Reading 19+ (40 dan)) va ikki haftalik aniq reja yozish.
Writing natijasini o'qish: AI examiner 4 mezon bo'yicha qo'ygan ballar, inglizcha izoh va xatolar ro'yxati; eng past mezonni topish va 5 ta xatoni tuzatish.
materials: Mock sessiyasi uchun: chop etilgan ism ro'yxati — kim qaysi kompyuterda o'tirgani va kim tugatgani belgilanadi.
Mock sessiyasi uchun: sessiyani o'tkazuvchi examiner ekranida Listening skripti (yozuv bo'lmasa o'qiladi) — o'quvchiga ko'rsatilmaydi.
Mock sessiyasi uchun: har stolda zaxira qog'oz va qalam — Listening paytida ism, raqam va sanalar qoralama qilinadi.

Mock sessiyasi uchun: doskada xona qoidalari (telefon sumkada, imtihon to'liq ekranda, ekrandan chiqish tizimda sanaladi) va qolgan vaqt. Tahlil darsi uchun: doskada Listening va Reading xom ball — band jadvallari (2-mashq).
Tahlil darsi: har o'quvchiga "Yetti sabab" jadvali va "Savol turi → Unit" xaritasi (quyidagi 3-mashq jadvali) chop etilgan holda.
Tahlil darsi: har o'quvchiga "Ikki haftalik reja" varaqasi — 6 qator, oxirida ustoz imzosi uchun joy.

Tahlil darsi: har o'quvchi o'z examiner javoblar varaqasini o'z ekranida (kompyuterda) yoki chop etilgan shaxsiy nusxada ko'radi. Proyektorda faqat to'g'ri javoblar va guruh statistikasi (qaysi savolda nechta xato) ko'rsatiladi — shaxsiy natijalar proyektorga chiqarilmaydi.
Tahlil darsi: har o'quvchining examiner tasdiqlagan Writing natijasi — 4 mezon bo'yicha ball, inglizcha izoh va grammatika/lug'at xatolari ro'yxati (o'z ekranida yoki chop etilgan nusxada).
timeline: Kirish: bugun — tahlil darsi

Mock alohida 150 daqiqalik sessiyada o'tgan (JonyOS → Imtihonlar → Mock testlar); bugun faqat natija va tahlil. Mock — o'lchov, jazo emas. Ballar ovoz chiqarib aytilmaydi, har kim o'z varaqasi bilan ishlaydi.
Natijani ochish
Har o'quvchi Listening va Reading xom ball va bandini, Writing bandini daftariga yozadi va maqsad bilan solishtiradi (kamida 5.5: Listening 18+, Reading 19+ (40 dan)).
Xom ball — band jadvali
Doskada ikkala jadval; jadval chegarasida bitta savol yarim bandni o'zgartirishi ko'rsatiladi (2-mashq).
Yetti sabab
Har sababga bitta tanish misol (1-mashq); sabablar jadvali tarqatiladi.
Javoblar varaqasi: Listening

Har kim o'z varaqasini savol-savol o'qiydi, har xatoga sabab raqami va Section turi yoziladi. Proyektorda faqat to'g'ri javoblar va guruh statistikasi; eng ko'p xato qilingan 3–4 savol uchun ustoz skriptdan faqat tegishli bitta gapni ko'rsatadi (bu gaplarni darsdan oldin examinerdan olib tayyorlab qo'ying).
Javoblar varaqasi: Reading
Passage bo'yicha ketma-ket; har xatoga sabab raqami va savol turi yoziladi.
Savol turi → Unit xaritasi
Har tur va har sabab necha marta chiqqani sanaladi; xatolar savol turi bo'yicha guruhlanadi va Unit 1–4 dagi qaysi darsga qaytish kerakligi topiladi (3-mashq).
Ikki haftalik reja
Har kim eng katta ikki naqsh bo'yicha 6 qatorli reja yozadi; juftlik o'qib tekshiradi.
Writing feedback
AI examiner natijasi: 4 mezon bo'yicha ball, inglizcha izoh, grammatika va lug'at xatolari; eng past mezon, 5 ta tuzatish va bitta odat (4-mashq).
Xulosa va vazifa
4-mashqdagi Writing odati reja varag'ining ostiga yoziladi; reja ustozga ko'rsatiladi va imzolanadi; xatolar daftari, yangi material va Writing xatboshisi uyda bajariladi.

intro: Bu — Mock 1 dan keyingi TAHLIL darsi. Imtihonning o'zi dars sonidan tashqaridagi alohida sessiyada o'tadi; bu 120 daqiqada natijalar savol-savol va savol turi bo'yicha tahlil qilinadi, Writing izohi ko'rib chiqiladi va ikki haftalik reja yoziladi. Yangi mavzu yo'q — Unit 1–4 da o'rganilgan savol turlari kombinatsiyalarining imtihon sharoitidagi natijasi tahlil qilinadi.

Mock sessiyasi (dars sonidan tashqarida, alohida kun): examiner JonyOS → Imtihonlar → Mock testlar bo'limidan guruh uchun mockni ochadi, o'quvchilar qat'iy rejimda (faqat kompyuter, to'liq ekran) ishlaydi: Listening ~30, Reading 60, Writing 60 daqiqa — jami 150 daqiqa, bitta o'tirishda. Speaking — filial imkon bersa, boshqa kuni examiner bilan: har o'quvchiga 11–14 daqiqa, 4 mezon bo'yicha; imkon bo'lmasa, bu mockda Speaking yo'q.

Sessiyada Listening yozuvi bo'lmasa, skriptni EXAMINER ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi: bir marta, bir tekis tezlikda (taxminan 150 so'z/daqiqa), rollarni ovoz bilan farqlab. Skript faqat examiner ekranida turadi.

Natija ikki raqam: XOM BALL (40 dan nechta) va BAND. Listening va Reading jadvallari bir xil emas: 26 ta to'g'ri javob Listeningda 6.5, Academic Readingda 6.0. Jadval chegarasida bitta savol yarim bandni o'zgartiradi (Listening 29 ta = 6.5, 30 ta = 7.0) — bo'sh javob qoldirmang.

Yetti sabab: 1) eshitmadim / topa olmadim; 2) eshitdim, lekin xato yozdim (imlo, ko'plik, raqam); 3) vaqt yetmadi; 4) savol turini noto'g'ri tushundim (so'z limiti, NOT GIVEN va FALSE farqi, TWO letters); 5) taxmin qildim; 6) bilardim, lekin javobni o'zgartirdim; 7) savoldagi so'zni yoki uning paraphrase'ini tanimadim (javob joyi oldimda edi, lekin sinonimni bilmadim) — davosi: paraphrase juftligini daftarga yozish va unit lug'atini takrorlash.

6.0 kursida tahlil SAVOL TURI bo'yicha olib boriladi. Har xatoning yonida savol turi yoziladi va "Savol turi → Unit" xaritasidan qaysi darsga qaytish kerakligi topiladi. Masalan, Matching headings da 3 ta xato — Unit 2 (3-dars) strategiyasi takrorlanadi va shu turdagi YANGI passage'lar ishlanadi (darsdagi Practice'larning javoblari o'quvchiga allaqachon ma'lum).
Kombinatsiya xatosini alohida belgilang: agar bir passage'da ikkinchi savol turiga vaqt yetmagan bo'lsa (3-sabab), muammo tur emas — xarita usuli va vaqt taqsimoti.

Maqsad: kamida 5.5: Listening 18+, Reading 19+ (40 dan). Maqsaddan past bo'lim — ikki haftalik rejaning birinchi qatori. Writing uchun raqamli maqsad qo'yilmaydi: Task 1 kursda 19–20-darslarda o'tiladi, shuning uchun bu mockdagi Writing bali — diagnostika (eng past mezon aniqlanadi).

WRITING natijasi: JonyOS AI examiner Writing'ni 4 IELTS mezoni bo'yicha baholaydi — Task Achievement (Task 1) / Task Response (Task 2), Coherence and Cohesion, Lexical Resource, Grammatical Range and Accuracy; Task 2 ikki barobar hisoblanadi. U inglizcha examiner izohi va grammatika/lug'at xatolari ro'yxatini beradi. Examiner 48 soat ichida bahoni tekshiradi yoki o'zgartiradi, shundan keyin natija e'lon qilinadi. Guruh ustozining vazifasi — tahlil darsida shu tasdiqlangan natija bilan ishlash. Har mezonga faqat butun ball qo'yiladi; .5 faqat o'rtacha — Writing bandida chiqadi.

Sessiya qoidasi: telefon sumkada, stolda emas. Qat'iy rejimda imtihon to'liq ekranda ishlanadi; qoidabuzarlik (boshqa varaq, oyna yoki ilovaga o'tish, to'liq ekrandan chiqish, brauzer kengaytmasi yoki ekran rasmini olishga urinish) tizimda sanaladi: 2 marta ogohlantirish beriladi, 3-chiqishda o'quvchi imtihondan chetlatiladi (chegarani examiner o'zgartirishi mumkin). Savol bo'lsa qo'l ko'tariladi.
formulas: Bo'sh reja ishlamaydi; uyda 3 daqiqa zaxira bilan ishlanadi
Writing: eng past mezon + 5 ta tuzatish
Writing bandini ko'taradigan bitta aniq odat
presentation: To'liq mock bitta darsga sig'adimi?

Yo'q. Mock — dars sonidan tashqaridagi alohida 150 daqiqalik sessiya (JonyOS → Imtihonlar → Mock testlar, qat'iy rejim, kompyuterda): Listening ~30, Reading 60, Writing 60 daqiqa. Speaking — filial imkon bersa, boshqa kuni examiner bilan (har o'quvchiga 11–14 daqiqa, 4 mezon). Bu 120 daqiqalik dars — faqat natijalar tahlili.
Mock nega kerak, darslar yetmaydimi?
Darsda har tur alohida ishlanadi; mockda hammasi aralash va vaqt bilan. Kombinatsiya ko'nikmasi faqat shu yerda o'lchanadi.
Ballim past chiqdi. Nima qilaman?

Avval sabablarni sanang. 2-sabab (imlo, raqam) eng tez tuzaladi — undan boshlang. 7-sabab (paraphrase'ni tanimadim) ham ko'p uchraydi, lekin u lug'at bilan sekin tuzaladi — uni rejaga doimiy qator qilib qo'ying.
Xatolarim har xil turlarda. Qayerdan boshlayman?
Eng ko'p xato bo'lgan ikki turdan. Xaritadan ularning darsini toping.
Listening skriptini keyin berasizmi?

To'liq skript berilmaydi — tahlil javoblar varaqasi orqali. Lekin guruhda eng ko'p xato qilingan 3–4 savol uchun ustoz skriptdan faqat tegishli bitta gapni ekranda ko'rsatadi: shunda 1-sabab (eshitmadim) bilan 7-sabab (paraphrase'ni tanimadim) ajraladi.
Vaqt yetmadi — bu qaysi sabab?
3-sabab. Davosi — xarita usuli va vaqt qoidasi (Unit 1): imtihonda har passage 20 daqiqa (javoblarni kiritish bilan); uyda mashqda 17 daqiqa — 3 daqiqa zaxira bilan.
Writingni ham tahlil qilamizmi?

Ha, bugun 20 daqiqa (4-mashq). Writing'ni JonyOS AI examiner 4 IELTS mezoni bo'yicha baholaydi (TA/TR, CC, LR, GRA; Task 2 ikki barobar), inglizcha izoh va grammatika/lug'at xatolari ro'yxatini beradi; examiner 48 soat ichida tekshiradi yoki o'zgartiradi, keyin natija e'lon qilinadi. Task 1 kursda 19–20-darslarda o'tiladi — hozirgi Task 1 bali diagnostika.
notes: Maktab qarori: mock imtihoni — dars sonidan tashqaridagi ALOHIDA 150 daqiqalik sessiya (JonyOS → Imtihonlar → Mock testlar, qat'iy rejim, faqat kompyuter): Listening ~30, Reading 60, Writing 60 daqiqa. Speaking — filial imkon bersa, boshqa kuni examiner bilan (har o'quvchiga 11–14 daqiqa, 4 mezon). Writing natijasi examiner tekshirgandan keyin (48 soat ichida) chiqadi, shuning uchun bu 120 daqiqalik tahlil darsini natijalar e'lon qilingandan KEYIN o'tkazing.
Natijalarni ochishdan oldin o'quvchilarga eslating: mock — o'lchov, jazo emas. Maqsad — keyingi ikki haftada qaysi darsga qaytishni bilish.
Tahlil qismida ustoz ham guruh bo'yicha umumiy naqshni yozib oladi: agar guruhning yarmi bitta turda xato qilgan bo'lsa, o'sha unit keyingi haftada sinfda qayta ko'riladi.
Bu kurs o'rtasidagi mock: natija Unit 5–8 ni boshlashdan oldin qaysi turlarni mustahkamlash kerakligini ko'rsatadi.

Sessiya kuni tartibi (dars timeline'iga kirmaydi): kompyuterlar tekshiriladi, mock JonyOS → Imtihonlar → Mock testlar bo'limidan ochiladi, ism ro'yxati va zaxira qog'oz tarqatiladi; telefon sumkaga, qat'iy rejim qoidalari ovoz chiqarib aytiladi. Listening skriptini (yozuv bo'lmasa) ikki marta o'qimang va tezlashtirmang. Reading va Writing paytida xona kuzatiladi, mazmun bo'yicha yordam berilmaydi (texnik savolga — beriladi), qolgan vaqt doskaga yozib boriladi.
mistakes: Har xatoga sabab va savol turi
Aniq dars, aniq miqdor, aniq kun
Noto'g'ri javob uchun jarima yo'q; bo'sh javob — kafolatlangan nol
Davosi boshqa: xarita va vaqt taqsimoti

class_ex.title: 1-mashq: Bu xato qaysi sababdan?
class_ex.instr: Ustoz xato javobni o'qiydi, o'quvchi yetti sababdan bittasini raqami bilan aytadi va "demak nima qilish kerak" deydi.
items: To'g'ri javob "Coundon", o'quvchi "Coundan" yozgan.
To'g'ri javob "two weeks", o'quvchi "two week" yozgan.
Reading Passage 3 dagi oxirgi 6 savol bo'sh qolgan.
"NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS" savoliga "their initial enthusiasm" yozilgan.
To'g'ri javob NOT GIVEN, o'quvchi FALSE belgilagan.
TWO letters savolida bitta harf yozilgan.
O'quvchi avval "B" yozib, keyin "C" ga o'zgartirgan; to'g'risi B edi.
Listening Section 4 da javob umuman yozilmagan, o'quvchi "tinglab ulgurmadim" deydi.
Savolda "the scheme was costly", matnda "the project required a large budget"; o'quvchi NOT GIVEN belgilagan (to'g'risi TRUE) va "costly bilan large budget bir xil ekanini bilmadim" deydi.
why: Harflashni oxirigacha tinglash — Unit 1 Listening (2-dars) harflash diktanti.
Ko'plik -s — javoblarni tekshirish vaqtida qarab chiqiladi (qog'ozda — transfer vaqti, kompyuterda — oxirgi tekshiruv daqiqalari).
Xarita usuli va vaqt (Unit 1 Reading): imtihonda har passage 20 daqiqa (javoblarni kiritish bilan); uyda mashqda 17 daqiqa — 3 daqiqa zaxira bilan.
So'z limiti: uch so'z — 0 ball.
Qarshi isbot gap bo'lmasa — NOT GIVEN.
TWO letters — ikkita harf, ikkalasi ham to'g'ri bo'lishi kerak (Unit 2).
Birinchi javobni isbotsiz o'zgartirmang.
Section 4 da tayyorlanish vaqtida savollarni oldindan o'qish (Unit 4 Listening).
costly = required a large budget. Paraphrase juftligini daftarga yozing va unit lug'atini takrorlang.

class_ex.instr: Doskadagi jadvaldan foydalanib bandni ayting. Listening va Academic Reading jadvallari farq qiladi.

why: Listening 16–17 = 5.0.

class_ex.title: 4-mashq: Writing — AI examiner izohi bo'yicha tahlil
class_ex.instr: Har o'quvchi examiner tasdiqlagan Writing natijasini ochadi: 4 mezon bo'yicha ball, inglizcha examiner izohi va grammatika/lug'at xatolari ro'yxati. Besh qadamni daftarda bajaring. Namuna (Madina) "Javobni ko'rsat" tugmasi ostida — ko'chirmang, o'z natijangiz bilan ishlang.
items: 1-qadam. Task 1 va Task 2 uchun 4 mezon bo'yicha ballaringizni yozing: Task Achievement (Task 1) / Task Response (Task 2), Coherence and Cohesion, Lexical Resource, Grammatical Range and Accuracy.
2-qadam. Eng past mezonni belgilang. Task 2 ikki barobar hisoblanishini eslang: qaysi task'dagi past ball Writing bandini ko'proq tushirgan?
3-qadam. Inglizcha izohdan eng muhim BITTA gapni toping va o'zbekchaga o'giring: examiner nimani so'rayapti?
4-qadam. Xatolar ro'yxatidan 5 ta xatoni tanlang: to'g'ri shaklini yozing va turini belgilang (grammatika yoki lug'at).
5-qadam. Eng past mezon uchun keyingi ikki haftada bajariladigan BITTA aniq odatni yozing.
answers: Madina. Task 1: TA 5, CC 6, LR 5, GRA 6. Task 2: TR 6, CC 6, LR 5, GRA 6.

Eng past ball — 5: Task 1 da TA va LR, Task 2 da LR. LR ikkala task'da past, Task 2 esa ikki barobar og'ir — shuning uchun Writing bandini eng ko'p Task 2 dagi LR 5 pastga tortgan; asosiy ish — LR. Task 1 dagi TA 5 — diagnostika (Task 1 19–20-darslarda o'tiladi).

"You rely on a narrow range of vocabulary and repeat key words such as 'problem' and 'important'." → So'z boyligingiz tor: "problem" va "important" so'zlarini qayta-qayta ishlatasiz — sinonim va paraphrase kerak (LR).

"a lot of informations" → "a lot of information" (grammatika); "make a crime" → "commit a crime" (lug'at); "The number of students have increased" → "The number of students has increased" (grammatika); "despite of the cost" → "despite the cost" (grammatika); "economical growth" → "economic growth" (lug'at).
Essay rejasida har body uchun 3 ta asosiy so'z va ularning sinonimini oldindan yozaman (problem → issue, challenge; important → significant, crucial) va har xatboshidan keyin takrorni tekshiraman.
why: Har mezonga faqat BUTUN ball qo'yiladi (masalan 5 yoki 6); .5 faqat o'rtacha — Writing bandida chiqadi.
Task 2 ikki barobar hisoblanadi: Task 2 dagi 1 ball farq Writing bandiga Task 1 dagiga qaraganda ko'proq ta'sir qiladi.
Izoh inglizcha — tushunmagan so'zni ustozdan so'rang. Izohdan bitta aniq harakat chiqishi kerak.
Tuzatilgan xato — keyingi ishda takrorlanmaydigan xato. Grammatika xatolari GRA ga, so'z tanlash, birikma va so'z yasalishi xatolari LR ga tegishli.
Odat kichik va aniq bo'lsin: "lug'atni boyitaman" emas, "har body uchun 3 ta sinonimni oldindan yozaman". Bu odat ikki haftalik reja varag'ining ostiga Writing qatori qilib yoziladi.
class_ex.note: Writing'ni JonyOS AI examiner 4 mezon bo'yicha baholaydi (Task 2 ikki barobar hisoblanadi), inglizcha izoh va xatolar ro'yxatini beradi; examiner 48 soat ichida tekshiradi yoki o'zgartiradi, natija shundan keyin e'lon qilinadi. Bu darsda faqat tasdiqlangan natija bilan ishlanadi. Task 2 5.0 kursida o'tilgan, Task 1 esa 6.0 da 19–20-darslarda o'tiladi — shuning uchun Task 1 bali DIAGNOSTIKA, asosiy e'tibor Task 2 ga. Ballni sinfda ovoz chiqarib aytmang.

lessons.title: Unit 5 Reading — Passage 2: Matching information + Matching features + Summary completion
lessons.grammar_topic: Uch savol turi bitta passage'da: Matching information + Matching features + Summary completion (Passage 2)
lessons.vocab_topic: Unit 5 (The world in our hands) — qayta tiklanadigan energiya, iqlim o'zgarishi, tabiatni asrash
lessons.book_ref: Complete IELTS Bands 5–6.5: Student's Book, Unit 5, 50–52-betlar (Reading Section 2); Workbook, Unit 5, 32–33-betlar. Practice 1–3 — Jony Academy matnlari.
objectives: Passage 2 da uch savol turi kelganda ishlash tartibini tanlash: avval tartibli tur (summary), keyin ismlar (matching features), oxirida matching information.
Matching information savolidagi birinchi so'zlardan ma'lumot TURINI aniqlash (estimate, comparison, suggestion, description) va xatboshidan aynan shu turdagi gapni topish.
Matching features uchun matndagi barcha ism va tashkilotlarni 2 daqiqada doiraga olib, har birining yoniga 2–3 so'zli izoh yozish.
Tuzoqni tanish: bitta xatboshida ikki tashkilot yoki bir xil raqam (2020) tilga olinsa, fikr aynan kimniki ekanini tekshirish.
Summary sarlavhasidan kerakli xatboshini topish va javobni so'z chegarasi (NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS) hamda so'z turiga mos ko'chirish.
materials: Student's Book, Unit 5, 50–52-betlar ("Out of Africa: solar energy from the Sahara") — sinfda birga ishlanadi.
Workbook, Unit 5, 32–33-betlar ("Russia's boreal forests and wild grasses could combat climate change") — mustaqil mashq.
Practice 1–3 matnlari chop etilgan varaqlar (har o'quvchiga) — pastdagi Reading bo'limidan.
Rangli qalamlar: ism/tashkilotlar — doira, matching information kalit g'oyasi — to'lqinli chiziq.
Doskada uch ustun: "Summary → qaysi xatbosh?", "Ismlar → qaysi xatboshilar?", "Information → ma'lumot turi".
timeline: Kirish
Savol: "O'zbekistonda qaysi qayta tiklanadigan energiya ishlatiladi? Quyosh panellarini qayerda ko'rgansiz?" — 3–4 o'quvchi javob beradi (SB 1-mashq).
Uch tur — bitta passage
Ustoz doskada: ishlash tartibi, har tur qoidasi, NEVER va USUALLY guruhlari, tuzoqlar.
Sinf mashqi
Matching information savollarida ma'lumot turini aniqlash va SB matnida tashkilotlar xaritasini tuzish.
Student's Book: Solar energy from the Sahara
Q1–13 birga: avval 10–13 (summary), keyin 6–9 (tashkilotlar), oxirida 1–5 (xatboshilar).
Workbook: Russia's boreal forests
20 daqiqa mustaqil, keyin javoblar isbot gap bilan tekshiriladi.
Practice 1
"Power from the sea" — 18 daqiqa vaqt bilan, keyin tahlil.
Practice 2
"Bringing back the beaver" — 18 daqiqa, xatolar daftariga yoziladi.
Xulosa va vazifa
Practice 3 va 30-Day Reading Challenge uyga; xatolar daftari to'ldiriladi.

intro: Passage 2 da 6.0 darajasida ko'pincha uch savol turi birga keladi. Student's Book'dagi Sahara matnida: 1–5 Matching information (qaysi xatboshida?), 6–9 Matching features (qaysi tashkilot?), 10–13 Summary completion (matndan ikki so'zgacha). Workbook'da ham aynan shu uchlik.

Muammo: uch turning ikkitasi NEVER guruhida — matching information va matching features savollari matn tartibida kelmaydi. Faqat summary odatda (USUALLY) tartibli va bitta-ikkita xatboshiga tegishli. Shuning uchun navbatni o'zgartiramiz.

TAVSIYA ETILGAN TARTIB: 1) sarlavha va kichik sarlavha — 30 soniya; 2) SUMMARY — sarlavhasi ("Concentrating Solar Power") kerakli xatboshini ko'rsatadi, uni o'qib 4 javobni yozasiz; 3) MATCHING FEATURES — matndagi barcha ism/tashkilotlarni doiraga olasiz (bu matnda ular ro'yxatda matn tartibida berilgan — ko'pincha shunday, lekin har doim emas) va gaplarni solishtirasiz; 4) MATCHING INFORMATION — endi matn tanish, eng oxirida ishlanadi.

Matching features: ro'yxatdagi variantlar ko'pincha savollardan ko'p (7 ta tashkilot — 4 ta savol). Ro'yxat ko'pincha (har doim emas) matn tartibida beriladi — 30 soniyada tekshiring; tartib mos kelsa, xarita tuzish ancha tezlashadi. Har ism yoniga 2–3 so'z yozing: "Abengoa — building 2 plants", "e-Parliament — start small".

Matching information: savolning boshidagi so'zlar ma'lumot TURINI aytadi — "estimates of" (raqam, hisob), "a comparison of" (ikki narsa solishtiriladi), "a suggestion for" (maslahat), "a mention of" (qisqa eslatma), "a short description of" (tasvir). Xatboshining asosiy g'oyasini emas, ichidagi bitta detalni qidirasiz (5.0 dagi headings bilan farqini eslang).

Uch tur bir-biriga yordam beradi: summary uchun o'qigan xatboshi, ismlar uchun chizgan xaritangiz — matching information uchun tayyor bilim. Oxirida 1–5 savollarning ko'pchiligini xotiradan joylashtirasiz, faqat tekshirish uchun qaytib o'qiysiz.
Vaqt: Passage 2 ga 20 daqiqa. Taxminan: summary — 5, matching features — 6, matching information — 7, tekshiruv — 2 daqiqa.
formulas: E ikki marta? NB ruxsat beradi
presentation: Nega 1–5 ni oxirida ishlaymiz?
Chunki ular tartibsiz va butun matnni qamraydi. Summary va ismlardan keyin matn allaqachon tanish bo'ladi.
Ro'yxatda 7 ta tashkilot, savol 4 ta. Qolganlari nima?
Ortiqcha variantlar — tuzoq. Ular matnda bor, lekin hech bir gapga mos kelmaydi.
Bitta xatboshida ikki tashkilot bor. Qanday ajrataman?
Fe'lga va egaga qarang: kim quryapti, kim qonun qabul qilgan, kim hisoblagan? Gap aynan kimga tegishli?
"NB You may use any letter more than once" nima degani?
Bitta xatbosh (masalan, E) ikki savolga javob bo'lishi mumkin. Ikki marta chiqsa, xato deb o'ylamang.
Summary'dagi so'z matndagidan boshqacha.
Normal: summary paraphrase qiladi ("situated in" = "building ... in"). Javob esa matndagi so'z, aynan o'sha shaklda.
Summary javobi uch so'z chiqdi.
Chegarani buzmang: kerakli ot odatda bitta so'z ("depressions"), ortiqcha sifat va artikl tashlanadi.
notes: 5.0 da matching information (25-dars), matching features (26-dars) va summary (14-dars) alohida o'rganilgan. Bugungi yangilik — uchalasini bitta passage'da, to'g'ri NAVBAT bilan yechish.
Tekshiruvda har javob uchun o'quvchidan ikki narsa so'rang: "isbot gap qaysi?" va "savoldagi qaysi so'z matnda qanday aytilgan?"
Kuchli o'quvchilarga: SB matnidagi 7 tashkilotning har biri haqida bir gapli izohni xotiradan aytish; zaif o'quvchilarga — faqat ism va xatboshi harfi.
mistakes: Matching information'ni birinchi ishlash va har savolga butun matnni o'qish
Tashkilot nomi yonidagi gapni o'ylamay tanlash (6-savolda DESERTEC — "by 2020")
Bitta harf ikki marta chiqqani uchun javobni o'zgartirish
To'rt so'z, chegara esa NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS — 0 ball

how: CORE — energiya va ekologiya mavzusidagi asosiy so'zlar; STRONG — Passage 2 dagi akademik fe'l va otlar; SUPER — maqola uslubidagi iboralar.
Har so'z bilan o'quvchi O'zbekiston haqida bitta gap tuzsin: "Solar panels are being installed on many roofs in Tashkent."
core: Renewable energy is becoming cheaper every year.
Qayta tiklanadigan energiya har yili arzonlashmoqda.
Most power stations still burn fossil fuels.
Aksariyat elektr stansiyalari hali ham qazilma yoqilg'i yoqadi.
The city wants to cut its emissions by half.
Shahar chiqindi gazlarni ikki barobar kamaytirmoqchi.
Iqlim o'zgarishi birinchi navbatda fermerlarga ta'sir qiladi.
We put two solar panels on our roof.
The plant generates electricity for 5,000 homes.
Stansiya 5000 ta uy uchun elektr ishlab chiqaradi.
The new turbines work at higher efficiency.
Yangi turbinalar yuqoriroq samaradorlik bilan ishlaydi.
Experts estimate the project will cost $2 billion.
Mutaxassislar loyiha 2 milliard dollar turadi deb taxmin qilishadi.
The old infrastructure cannot carry so much power.
Eski infratuzilma bunchalik ko'p energiyani o'tkaza olmaydi.
Yo'l qurish tabiiy yashash muhitini buzadi.
strong: One drawback of solar power is that it needs sunshine.
Quyosh energiyasining bir kamchiligi — quyosh kerakligi.
Farmers receive a subsidy for planting trees.
Fermerlar daraxt ekish uchun subsidiya oladi.
A consortium of banks paid for the project.
I was sceptical until I saw the results.
Coastal cities are vulnerable to rising sea levels.
Qirg'oq shaharlari dengiz sathi ko'tarilishiga qarshi himoyasiz.
Grass grew over the abandoned fields.
Tashlab qo'yilgan dalalarni o't bosib ketdi.
super: When the profits appeared, investors jumped in.
Wind power is now produced on a large scale.
Shamol energiyasi endi katta miqyosda ishlab chiqariladi.
Planting trees can offset some of our emissions.
Daraxt ekish chiqindilarimizning bir qismini qoplashi mumkin.
Some damage to the climate may be irreversible.
Iqlimga yetkazilgan ba'zi zararni qaytarib bo'lmasligi mumkin.

class_ex.title: Ma'lumot turini aniqlash (SB, 3-mashq)
class_ex.instr: Matnni ochmasdan, SB 1–5 savollarining kalit so'zini tagiga chizing va xatboshida qanday gap qidirish kerakligini ayting.
items: 1 a mention of systems which could not be used
2 estimates of the quantity of power the Sahara could produce
3 a suggestion for how to convince organisations about the Sahara's potential
4 a short description of the Sahara at present
5 a comparison of the costs of two different energy sources
answers: maslahat: "if it can be shown ... they will..."
Saharaning hozirgi holati: harorat, quruq, bo'sh
why: "Could not be used" — salbiy: "would not be suitable", "cannot" kabi so'zlarni qidiring.
"Estimates" — ko'plik: bir nechta hisob-kitob va raqam bo'lishi kerak.
"Suggestion" — kimdir nima qilish kerakligini aytadi; "convince" = ishontirish, isbot ko'rsatish.
"At present" — tarix yoki kelajak emas, hozirgi tasvir.
"Comparison" — qiyosiy daraja (cheaper, more expensive) va ikkita manba nomi.
class_ex.note: Uchinchi mashq savollari ("Hamma harf kerakmi?" — yo'q; "Bitta harf ikki marta?" — ha) ni ham og'zaki so'rang.

class_ex.title: Tashkilotlar xaritasi (SB, 5-mashq)
class_ex.instr: SB matnini tez ko'zdan kechiring va ro'yxatdagi har tashkilot qaysi xatboshida tilga olinganini yozing.
items: A Exploration Architecture
B DESERTEC
C ABB Power Technologies
D Aerospace Centre
E Abengoa
F The European Parliament
G e-Parliament
why: Michael Pawlyn — Exploration Architecture direktori; Sahara Forest Project haqida.
Gerry Wolff boshqaradigan konsorsium — $59 billion hisobi.
Gunnar Asplund — kabellar va narx haqida.
Germaniyaning Aerospace Centre — infratuzilmani almashtirish narxi.
Sevilyadagi kompaniya — Jazoir va Marokashda stansiya qurmoqda.
Yevropa Parlamenti — 2020 yilgacha 20% maqsadi haqidagi qonun.
Nicholas Dunlop — "Lego method".
class_ex.note: Bu matnda ro'yxat tartibi matn tartibi bilan bir xil ekanini ko'rsating: B, D, E, E, F, F, G — o'sib boradi. Imtihonda ro'yxat ko'pincha (har doim emas) shunday beriladi — 30 soniyada tekshiring; mos kelsa, bu tezlik beradi. SB 52-betdagi Exam advice "they are listed in the order they appear in the passage" deydi — bu matnda shunday, lekin har bir yangi testda tartibni o'zingiz tekshiring.

readings.title: Student's Book: Out of Africa — solar energy from the Sahara
readings.qtype: Matching information (1–5) + Matching features (6–9) + Summary completion (10–13)
readings.source: Complete IELTS 5–6.5, Student's Book, Unit 5 — sinfda tushuntirish
readings.book_ref: Student's Book, 50–52-betlar. Kitob sahifalari quyida rasm sifatida berilgan (chap ustundagi Vocabulary mashqlari bu darsda ishlatilmaydi).
paraphrases: systems which could not be used
existing infrastructures ... would not be suitable
estimates of the quantity of power
began to calculate just how much energy the Sahara holds
if it can be shown ... companies and governments will soon jump in
some areas reach 45 degrees ... dry and empty
a lot cheaper to burn coal than to make solar power
set a time for achieving an objective
transmitting small amounts of solar power ... piece by piece
experimenting ... in other parts of the world
testing solar plants in Oman and the United Arab Emirates
situated in ... to allow sea water to run in
areas below sea level ... so that sea water can flow into them

tasks.title: Questions 1–5
tasks.type: Matching information — paragraphs A–G
tasks.instr: Which paragraph contains the following information? Harfni yozing. NB — bitta harf bir necha marta ishlatilishi mumkin, ba'zi xatboshilar umuman kerak emas. Bu guruhni OXIRIDA ishlang.
items: 1 a mention of systems which could not be used
2 estimates of the quantity of power the Sahara could produce
3 a suggestion for how to convince organisations about the Sahara's potential
4 a short description of the Sahara at present
5 a comparison of the costs of two different energy sources
why: E: mavjud infratuzilma "would not be suitable for carrying the amount of electricity generated by the Sahara". "Could not be used" = "would not be suitable".
B: olimlar Sahara qancha energiya berishini hisoblagan — 90,600 va 15,500 kv. km misollari. Ko'plikdagi "estimates" — ikkita raqam.
G: "If it can be shown that power from the Sahara can be produced profitably ... companies and governments will soon jump in" — kichikdan boshlab, isbot ko'rsatish.
A: "Dry and empty. Some areas of the Sahara reach 45 degrees" — hozirgi tasvir. Tuzoq: C da ham Sahara haqida, lekin texnologiya tasviri.
E: "It's a lot cheaper to burn coal than to make solar power in the Sahara" — ko'mir va quyosh. D da faqat bitta narx ($59 billion) — taqqoslash yo'q.
tasks.note: 1 va 5 — ikkalasi ham E. O'quvchilar ko'pincha ikkinchi E ni "xato" deb o'zgartiradi — NB qatorini ko'rsating.

tasks.title: Questions 6–9
tasks.type: Matching features — List of Organisations A–G
tasks.instr: Har gapni ro'yxatdagi to'g'ri tashkilot bilan moslang. Avval matndagi barcha tashkilot nomlarini doiraga oling; NB — bitta harf bir necha marta ishlatilishi mumkin. Sinf mashqidagi xaritadan foydalaning.
items: 6 They have set a time for achieving an objective.
7 They believe that successful small-scale projects will demonstrate that larger projects are possible.
8 They have a number of renewable energy projects under construction.
9 They are already experimenting with solar-energy installations in other parts of the world.
why: F: "The European Parliament has passed a law that aids investors who help the continent reach its goal of getting 20% ... by 2020". Tuzoq B: DESERTEC ham "by 2020" deydi, lekin bu narx hisobi, maqsad emas.
G: Dunlop "small amounts of solar power" dan boshlashni, "the Lego method" ni taklif qiladi — muvaffaqiyat isbotlansa, katta loyihalar keladi.
E: Abengoa "is building one solar-thermal plant in Algeria and another in Morocco". "Under construction" = "is building". Uchinchisi (Misr) — boshqa korxona.

A: Pawlyn — Exploration Architecture direktori. Bu kompaniya Sahara Forest Project'ni tashkil etgan uch britaniyalik kompaniyadan biri, loyiha esa "is testing solar plants in Oman and the United Arab Emirates" (sinovni Pawlyn emas, loyiha o'tkazmoqda). "Experimenting" = "testing"; "other parts of the world" = Oman va BAA.
tasks.note: C, D, B variantlari ishlatilmaydi — ular ortiqcha. 6-savolda B ni tanlagan o'quvchiga: "2020" so'zi ikki joyda, lekin "objective/goal" faqat F da.

tasks.title: Questions 10–13
tasks.type: Summary completion — NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS from the passage
tasks.instr: Sarlavha "Concentrating Solar Power (CSP)" — C xatboshisi. Bu guruhni BIRINCHI ishlang.
why: "CSP utilises mirrors which focus light on water pipes or boilers". "By using" dan keyin ot — "mirrors".
"To produce very hot steam to operate the turbines". "High-temperature" = "very hot".
"In areas below sea level (the Sahara has several such depressions)". "Areas below sea level" — to'rt so'z, chegara esa NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS; shuning uchun "depressions" (bitta so'z, ko'plikda).

readings.title: Practice 1: Power from the sea
readings.qtype: Matching information (1–5) + Matching features (6–9) + Summary completion (10–13)
readings.source: Jony Academy — yangi matn (Passage 2 darajasi); ismlar o'quv maqsadida to'qilgan
text: A  When the world's first offshore wind farm was switched on off the coast of Denmark in 1991, it consisted of just eleven small turbines, and many engineers regarded it as an expensive experiment. Three decades later, wind farms at sea supply a significant share of the electricity used in several northern European countries, and the largest turbines now stand taller than most city office buildings. A single turn of their enormous blades can produce enough electricity to run an ordinary home for many hours.

B  The main attraction of building at sea is the wind itself. Out on the open water there are no hills, trees or buildings to slow the air down, so winds are both stronger and more constant than on land. In addition, turbines placed far from the coast are rarely seen or heard by anyone, which removes one of the most common objections to wind power. 'On land, the biggest obstacle is usually not engineering but neighbours,' says Marta Lind, an engineer who has worked on several North Sea projects. 'At sea, the difficulties are technical, and technical problems can be solved.'

C  Those difficulties are considerable. Most offshore turbines stand on foundations made of steel or concrete and fixed to the seabed, which is only practical in water less than about fifty metres deep. For deeper seas, engineers have developed floating turbines. Instead of resting on the bottom, each turbine is mounted on a large platform that is partly filled with water to keep it stable, and the platform is held in position by cables attached to heavy anchors on the seabed. The electricity then travels to the shore through cables buried beneath the sea floor.

D  Environmental groups have generally welcomed offshore wind, but not without reservations. Seabirds can be killed by the blades, and the noise of hammering foundations into the seabed may disturb whales and dolphins. Marine biologist Tomas Reyes, however, points to an unexpected benefit. 'Within a few years the foundations are covered in mussels and seaweed, and fish gather around them,' he explains. 'In effect, a wind farm can become an artificial reef.' He adds that because fishing boats usually stay out of these areas, some fish populations have a chance to recover.

E  Not everyone sees that as good news. Fishing communities complain that wind farms close traditional fishing grounds and that they are rarely consulted before a site is chosen. Peter Holm, who represents a group of small fishing businesses, says the turbines themselves are not the problem. 'We are not against clean energy,' he says. 'We simply want to be involved from the start, instead of being told about a project when all the decisions have already been made.'

F  Cost has long been the main argument against offshore wind. Building and maintaining machines in salt water and storms is far more expensive than doing so on land. Yet prices have fallen sharply over the past decade as turbines have grown larger and construction methods have improved. Government adviser Sara Novak believes the industry has reached a turning point. 'Ten years ago, electricity from offshore wind cost much more than power from gas,' she says. 'In many places today the difference has almost disappeared.'

G  The greatest remaining challenge may be what happens when the wind drops or suddenly becomes much stronger. Existing electricity networks were designed for power stations that produce a steady supply, and they cannot always absorb sudden surges from the sea. Engineers are therefore testing ways of storing surplus energy, for example by using it to produce hydrogen, which can be kept and burned later. Marta Lind is optimistic. In her view, within twenty years the question will not be whether offshore wind can meet a country's needs, but how quickly the networks can be rebuilt to carry it.
paraphrases: removes one of the most common objections
the size of the first wind farm
consisted of just eleven small turbines
keeping extra energy for later use
storing surplus energy ... which can be kept and burned later
fish gather around them ... a chance to recover

readings.title: Practice 2: Bringing back the beaver
readings.qtype: Matching information (1–5) + Matching features (6–9) + Summary completion (10–13)
readings.source: Jony Academy — yangi matn (Passage 2 darajasi); ismlar o'quv maqsadida to'qilgan
text: A  Beavers were once common in rivers across Europe and northern Asia. Over the centuries, however, they were hunted in huge numbers, partly for their thick fur and partly for a strong-smelling substance they produce, which was used in medicines and perfumes. By the early twentieth century only small groups survived in a few isolated areas. Since then, protection and reintroduction programmes have been remarkably successful, and the number of beavers in Europe is now thought to be well over a million. In Britain, where the animal had disappeared several hundred years earlier, the first officially approved release into the wild did not take place until the early twenty-first century.

B  Few animals change their surroundings as dramatically as beavers do. Using their powerful teeth, they cut down young trees and use the branches, together with stones and mud, to build dams across streams. Water collects behind each dam and forms a pond. In the middle of this pond the beavers construct their home, known as a lodge. Its entrances are always underwater, which makes it very difficult for predators such as wolves to get inside.

C  For people living downstream, these dams can bring real benefits. During heavy rain, the ponds hold back large quantities of water and release it slowly over several days, reducing the risk of sudden floods. 'A series of beaver dams works rather like a sponge,' explains hydrologist Emma Clarke. 'It will not prevent every flood, but it can reduce the peak flow that reaches the towns further down the valley, and that is often where the most expensive damage happens.' Beaver ponds also trap soil and pollution, so the water that leaves them tends to be cleaner.

D  The ponds are equally valuable for wildlife. Dead trees standing in the water attract insects and woodpeckers, while the still, shallow edges are ideal for frogs, dragonflies and water birds. Ecologist James Ward has studied several sites where beavers were released. 'Within five years, the variety of species at some of them had increased dramatically,' he says. 'The ponds act as nurseries, where young fish and frogs can grow without being carried away by fast-moving water.'

E  Not everyone is pleased to see the animals return, however. Farmers complain that dams can flood valuable fields and block drainage ditches, and that beavers sometimes damage fruit trees. In some regions, landowners can now receive compensation for these losses. Farmer Tom Baxter, whose land lies beside a river where beavers have settled, accepts that they have a place in the countryside. 'My problem is the paperwork,' he says. 'When a dam floods my field, I need permission to remove it within days, not months.'

F  Managing these conflicts is now a major part of conservation work. In several countries, beavers that cause serious problems can be caught and moved to more suitable rivers, and in some places simple pipes are fitted through dams to keep water at a safe level. Other measures are even more basic: wire fences can be placed around individual trees that owners want to protect, and some landowners simply accept a small amount of damage as the price of a healthier river. Conservation officer Nadia Rossi believes that the most effective tool is knowledge. 'Many of the fears people have come from stories rather than facts,' she says. 'When landowners understand how beavers behave, they are far more willing to share the river with them.'

readings.title: Practice 3 (uyga): Gardens on the roof
readings.qtype: Matching information (1–5) + Matching features (6–9) + Summary completion (10–13)
readings.source: Jony Academy — yangi matn (Passage 2 darajasi), uy vazifasi; ismlar o'quv maqsadida to'qilgan
text: A  Covering a roof with plants is not a new idea. In Scandinavia, farmhouses have been built with roofs of grass and earth for centuries, because the thick layer helped to keep homes warm through long winters. The modern green roof, however, is a much more technical product. It was developed largely in Germany in the second half of the twentieth century, and today green roofs can be seen on offices, schools, shopping centres and even bus shelters in cities around the world.

B  A modern green roof is built in layers. At the bottom is a waterproof membrane that stops water from entering the building. Above this lies a root barrier, which prevents plant roots from growing into the roof and damaging it. Next comes a drainage layer that allows extra water to run away, and on top of that a growing medium, which is much lighter than ordinary garden soil. Most roofs are planted with low-growing species such as sedum, which can survive long periods of dry weather and need very little care.

C  One of the main reasons cities are interested in green roofs is rain. In a typical city, most surfaces are hard, so rainwater runs straight into the drains, which can quickly become overloaded during a storm. A green roof acts differently: the plants and growing medium absorb a large part of the rain and release it slowly, partly through evaporation. 'We used to think of drains and roofs as completely separate problems,' says urban planner Leila Haddad. 'In fact, every roof is part of a city's water system, and it should be planned that way.'

D  Green roofs also affect temperature. Cities are usually several degrees warmer than the surrounding countryside, especially at night, because concrete and asphalt store heat. Plants cool the air around them, and the layers of a green roof protect the building below from the summer sun. Building engineer Oliver Grant points out, however, that the benefit is not spread evenly. 'The rooms directly under the roof gain the most,' he says. 'In a tall building, people on the lower floors may notice very little difference.'

E  For wildlife, a green roof can be a small island in a desert of concrete. Bees, butterflies and beetles quickly find these spaces, and some birds use them for feeding and even nesting. Ecologist Ana Sousa warns that not all green roofs are equally useful. 'A roof covered with a single type of plant looks neat, but it offers food for very few species,' she explains. 'If we want real variety, we need different plants, some deeper soil and even a few stones or pieces of dead wood.'

F  Despite these advantages, green roofs remain relatively uncommon. They cost more to install than conventional roofs, and a roof full of wet soil is heavy, so many older buildings would need to be strengthened before one could be added. Property developer Ben Carter admits that price is the main obstacle. 'Most builders know green roofs are a good idea,' he says. 'But when a client compares the first bill, the ordinary roof usually wins, even if the green one saves money over thirty years.'

G  To change this situation, a number of cities now require green roofs on certain types of new building, while others offer grants or lower taxes to owners who install them. Some also allow developers to build slightly larger buildings if they include a planted roof. Supporters hope that these measures will make green roofs as ordinary as solar panels, turning thousands of empty grey surfaces into living spaces.

kahoot.explain: Summary sarlavhasi matnning qaysi qismi (odatda bir-ikki xatbosh) haqida ekanini ko'rsatadi — faqat o'sha qismni diqqat bilan o'qiymiz.

kahoot.q: Summary: 'The panels sit on strong ___ frames.' Text: 'The panels are placed on strong metal frames.' Answer?
kahoot.explain: 'Strong' va 'frames' gapda allaqachon bor — takrorlansa javob noto'g'ri, faqat 'metal' yoziladi.

kahoot.q: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS. Text: 'The city bought a fleet of small electric buses.' Gap: 'The city now uses ___.' Best answer?
kahoot.explain: 'Electric buses' — ikki so'z; qolgan variantlar uch-to'rt so'z va chegarani buzadi (0 ball).

kahoot.q: What do matching information questions usually ask you to find?
options: one small detail inside a paragraph
the main idea of every paragraph
the title of the whole passage
the first sentence of a paragraph
kahoot.explain: Matching information — headings emas: xatboshining asosiy g'oyasi emas, ichidagi bitta detal (raqam, maslahat, taqqoslash) qidiriladi.

kahoot.q: Information: 'a suggestion for saving energy'. Which sentence from a text matches this type?
options: 'Energy use rose by five per cent last year.'
'Most homes here use gas for heating.'
kahoot.explain: 'Suggestion' — maslahat: kimdir nima qilish kerakligini aytadi ('should').

kahoot.q: Information: 'an estimate of future costs'. Which sentence from a text matches this type?
options: 'The new bridge may cost about $2 million.'
'The old bridge cost $2 million to build in 1990.'
'The bridge is cheaper than the old tunnel.'
'The bridge should be repaired every year.'
kahoot.explain: 'Estimate' — taxminiy hisob: kelajak ('may cost') va taxminiy raqam ('about'); o'tgan fakt yoki taqqoslash emas.

kahoot.q: The instructions say 'NB You may use any letter more than once.' What does this mean?
options: One paragraph may answer two questions
Every paragraph must be used once
You may write two letters per answer
The answers follow the paragraph order
kahoot.explain: Bitta xatbosh ikki savolga javob bo'lishi mumkin — harf ikki marta chiqsa, faqat shu sababli javobni o'zgartirmang.

kahoot.q: Text: 'The council rejected the plan and was criticised by Green Action.' Statement: 'They opposed the plan.' Who?
kahoot.explain: Fe'lga va egaga qarang: rejani rad etgan ('rejected') — council; Green Action rejani emas, council'ni tanqid qilgan ('criticised').

kahoot.q: In matching features, what is true about the list of names?
options: It is often, not always, in text order
It is always in alphabetical order
It always follows the question order
It never matches the order of the passage
kahoot.explain: Ro'yxat ko'pincha matn tartibida beriladi, lekin har doim emas — 30 soniyada tekshirib, keyin xarita tuzing.

kahoot.q: Seven names are listed, but there are only four statements. What does this mean?
options: Some names will not be used
Every name is used at least once
Two names go with each statement
The extra names are not in the text
kahoot.explain: Ortiqcha variantlar tuzoq: ular matnda bor, lekin hech bir gapga mos kelmaydi.

kahoot.q: Choose the best verb: 'The government plans to ___ carbon emissions by 30% by 2035.'
kahoot.explain: 'Cut / reduce emissions' — chiqindi gazlarni kamaytirmoq; to'g'ri birikma.

kahoot.q: Which of these is a renewable source of energy?
kahoot.explain: Shamol tugamaydigan manba — qayta tiklanadigan energiya; ko'mir, gaz va neft — qazilma yoqilg'i (fossil fuels).

kahoot.q: 'One drawback of the plan is its high cost.' Here 'drawback' means ...
kahoot.explain: 'Drawback' = kamchilik, noqulay tomon (disadvantage).

kahoot.q: A government subsidy for solar panels is ...
options: money that helps pay for them
a report that criticises their use
kahoot.explain: 'Subsidy' — davlatning moliyaviy yordami: narxning bir qismini davlat to'laydi.

kahoot.q: 'At first, many engineers were sceptical about the idea.' This means they ...
kahoot.explain: 'Sceptical' — shubha bilan qaraydigan, ishonqiramaydigan: g'oya ishlashiga shubha qilishgan.

kahoot.q: 'Low-lying coastal towns are vulnerable to flooding.' 'Vulnerable to' means ...
kahoot.explain: 'Vulnerable to' — ...ga qarshi zaif, osongina zarar ko'radigan.

kahoot.q: 'The company plants trees to offset its emissions.' Here 'offset' means ...
kahoot.explain: 'Offset' (fe'l) — o'rnini qoplamoq, muvozanatlamoq: daraxtlar chiqindi gazning bir qismini qoplaydi.

kahoot.q: If damage to the environment is irreversible, it ...
kahoot.explain: 'Irreversible' — qaytarib bo'lmaydigan: avvalgi holatga qaytarib bo'lmaydi.

lessons.title: Unit 5 Listening — Section 1: Note completion + Table completion
lessons.grammar_topic: Section 1 kombinatsiyasi: Note completion + Table completion (so'z chegarasi har guruhda boshqa)
lessons.vocab_topic: Unit 5 (The world in our hands) — eko-sayohat, ko'ngillilar tashkiloti, tabiatni asrash loyihalari
lessons.book_ref: Complete IELTS Bands 5–6.5: Student's Book, Unit 5, 48–49-betlar (Listening Section 1, CD1 Track 19–20); Workbook, Unit 5, 30-bet (Listening Section 1, Track 6). Oxirgi mashq — Jony Academy skripti.
objectives: Bitta Section 1 da ikki guruhning so'z chegarasi har xil ekanini tayyorlanish vaqtida belgilash (TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER → ONE OR TWO WORDS → ONE WORD).
Qisqa yozilgan notes'dagi bo'shliqqa qanday ma'lumot kerakligini oldingi va keyingi so'zdan aniqlash (£ → raqam; "for advance payments" → ot).
Jadvalni qator bo'yicha tinglash: ustun sarlavhalari (type / accommodation / advantage) har qatorda qaysi ma'lumot kelishini aytadi.
Tuzatish va chalg'ituvchi ma'lumotni tanish: "originally ... but actually", "over 300 groups ... 150,000 members".
Raqamlarni son bilan (1,750; 130,000) va ot ko'pligini (cyclists, fences) to'g'ri yozish.
materials: Student's Book, Unit 5, 48–49-betlar — savollar sahifasi (quyida rasm), CD1 Track 19 va 20 audiosi.
Workbook, Unit 5, 30-bet — savollar sahifasi va Track 6 audiosi (imtihon rejimi, bir marta).

Recording script rasmlari — ustozda; tekshiruvdan keyin ekranga chiqariladi. Uy vazifasi uchun guruhga faqat ikkitasi yuboriladi: SB Track 20 skripti (shadowing uchun) va WB Track 6 ning 2-qismi skripti (diktant topshirilgandan keyin).

Jony Academy skripti ("Green Weekend") — ustoz o'qiydi, ikkinchi rolni kuchli o'quvchi yoki ikkinchi ustoz o'qishi mumkin. Audio yo'q: taxminan 150 so'z/daqiqa tezlikda o'qing va rollarni ovoz bilan farqlang. Rolni o'qigan o'quvchi savollarni yechmaydi — tahlilda unga skriptdan tuzoqlarni (tuzatilgan son, o'zgargan kun, uchta raqam, eski qoida) topib, sinfga tushuntirishni topshiring.
Kolonka yoki quloqchin; doskada uch ramka: "TWO WORDS + NUMBER", "ONE OR TWO WORDS", "ONE WORD".
timeline: Kirish

Jony Academy: Green Weekend

Uyga: shadowing, raqam-harflash diktanti va xatolar daftari.

intro: Section 1 — kundalik suhbat (sayohat agentligi, ko'ngillilar tashkiloti, ro'yxatdan o'tish). 6.0 darajasida bu yerda ko'pincha ikki xil "completion" keladi: avval notes (qisqa yozuvlar), keyin table (jadval). Ikkalasi ham bo'shliq to'ldirish, lekin o'qish usuli boshqa.

ENG MUHIM FARQ — so'z chegarasi. Student's Book'da Q1–6: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER, Q7–10: ONE OR TWO WORDS. Workbook'da Q1–6: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER, Q7–10: ONE WORD. Har guruh ko'rsatmasini alohida o'qing va ramkaga oling — ikkinchi guruhda ko'pchilik birinchisining qoidasi bilan yozib, ball yo'qotadi.

NOTES: gaplar to'liq emas ("Will pay up to £ ___", "Needs quote for ___ during holiday"). Bo'shliq atrofidagi so'z turi aytadi: £ dan keyin — raqam; "for" dan keyin — ot; "a ___" — birlikdagi ot. Notes'da bor so'zni (£, "on plane") javobga qo'shmang.

TABLE: avval jadval sarlavhasi va ustun nomlarini o'qing (type of holiday / accommodation / advantage). Suhbat odatda QATOR bo'yicha boradi: bitta joy haqida uchala ustun, keyin keyingi joy. Qatordagi tayyor katakchalar ("watching animals", "village house") — qayerda turganingizni bildiruvchi "belgi".

TUZOQLAR: 1) tuzatish — "I originally planned three weeks, but actually two would be better" → oxirgi javob; 2) yaqin raqamlar — "over 300 groups and around 150,000 members" → jadvalda "300 ___" — demak "groups"; 3) o'xshash ma'noli ibora — audioda avval "salaried people" (boshqa loyihalar haqida), keyin "very few, if any, paid staff"; notes'dagi "do not have any" ga ikkinchisi mos, javob — "paid staff".
Transfer: raqam — son bilan va vergul bilan (1,750; 130,000); ko'plik -s (cyclists, fences); imlo (vegetarian, insurance). Nom bosh harf bilan (City Farms, Action).
formulas: Table: ustun va qator nomlarini o'qing
presentation: Notes'da "£" bor. Men ham yozamanmi?
Yo'q. Faqat raqam: 1,750. Belgi allaqachon berilgan.
"ONE OR TWO WORDS" va "ONE WORD" farqi katta-mi?
Ha. "local family" birinchisida to'g'ri, ikkinchisida xato bo'ladi. Har guruh ko'rsatmasini qayta o'qing.
Jadvalda qatorlar tartibi buzilishi mumkinmi?
Odatda yo'q: agent joylarni jadval tartibida aytadi. Lekin bitta qator ichida ustunlar aralash kelishi mumkin.
Raqam jadvalda allaqachon bor (300 ___). Nima yozaman?
Raqamdan keyingi otni: "300 groups". 150,000 — boshqa narsa (a'zolar) soni.
Gapiruvchi o'z fikrini o'zgartirdi.
Oxirgi, tasdiqlangan javobni yozing: "originally ... but actually" dan keyingisi.
Q6 bilan Q7 orasida pauza bo'ladimi?
Student's Book'da ha — ikki alohida track. Workbook'da pauza bor; shu vaqtda jadval ustunlarini o'qing.
notes: 5.0 da note completion (5-dars) va table completion (16-dars) alohida o'rganilgan. Bugun ular bitta section'da ketma-ket keladi va har birining so'z chegarasi boshqa — asosiy ko'nikma shu.
Tekshiruvda har javobdan keyin skriptdagi gapni ekranga chiqaring; tuzatish va chalg'ituvchi raqamni boshqa rang bilan belgilang.
Kuchli o'quvchilarga: Workbook audiosini skriptsiz ikkinchi marta tinglab, har tashkilot haqida bitta qo'shimcha faktni yozish (branches soni, members soni).

how: CORE — sayohat bron qilish va ko'ngillilar ishi so'zlari; STRONG — tabiatni asrash; SUPER — Section 1 suhbatidagi iboralar.
Har o'quvchi o'zi uchun eko-sayohat "buyurtmasi"ni 4 gapda aytadi: qancha muddat, qancha pul, qanday talablar.
core: We went on an eco-holiday in the mountains.
The travel agent found three options for us.
Sayohat agenti biz uchun uchta variant topdi.
You get a discount if you pay in advance.
Can you give me a quote for the flight?
Parvoz uchun narx aytib bera olasizmi?
Do I need a visa for Malaysia?
Tashkilotga 20 000 dan ortiq ko'ngilli yordam beradi.
The accommodation is a simple hostel.
The project clears litter from rural areas.
Volunteers count wildlife species in the park.
Ko'ngillilar bog'dagi yovvoyi hayvon turlarini sanaydi.

U yovvoyi tabiatni muhofaza qilish sohasida ishlaydi.
Cycling is a sustainable form of transport.
The island is still unspoilt by tourism.
Most of the workers are volunteers, not salaried staff.
Ishchilarning ko'pi ko'ngilli, maoshli xodim emas.
I can help with administrative work.
Men idora ishlarida yordam bera olaman.

Ular menga qisqa muddatda dam olish topib berishdi.
Bear in mind that visas take time.

Ko'ngillilikni sinab ko'ring — o'zgarish ham dam olishdek.

class_ex.title: Bo'shliq turini bashorat qilish (SB, 2- va 4-mashq)
class_ex.instr: Audioni tinglashdan oldin SB Q1–10 dagi har bo'shliqqa qanday ma'lumot kerakligini ayting.
items: 1 Length of holiday: ___
2 Will pay up to £ ___
3 Told him about ___ for advance payments
4 Needs quote for ___ during holiday
5 Requires ___ on plane
6 Must check if he needs a ___
7 accommodation: house in a ___
8 type of holiday: live with a ___
9 type of holiday: working in a ___
10 advantage: holiday location without ___
answers: ot — sayohat paytidagi xizmat (sug'urta? mashina ijarasi? gid?)
ot — parvozdagi maxsus talab (ovqat? o'rindiq? yordam?)
why: "Length" — qancha vaqt: kun, hafta, oy.
£ belgisi turibdi — faqat raqam yoziladi.
"for advance payments" — oldindan to'lov uchun beriladigan narsa.
"quote" — narx taklifi; sayohat paytida kerak bo'ladigan xizmat.
"on plane" — parvozdagi maxsus talab.
"a ___" — birlikdagi ot; sayohatdan oldin tekshiriladigan narsa.
"house in a" — uy qayerda joylashgan?
"live with a" — kim bilan yashaydi?
"working in a" — qayerda ishlaydi?
"without" — ko'pincha salbiy narsa: mashinalar, turistlar, shovqin.
class_ex.note: Bashoratlarni doskada qoldiring; tinglashdan keyin qaysilari to'g'ri chiqqanini belgilang. Q7–10 chegarasi (ONE OR TWO WORDS) Q1–6 dan farq qilishini alohida ta'kidlang.

class_ex.title: "Oxirgi javob" — tuzoq mashqi
class_ex.instr: Ustoz gapni o'qiydi. O'quvchilar javobni aytadi va tuzoqni ko'rsatadi.
items: "We booked ten nights at first, but in the end we only stayed a week." — Length of stay?
"Rooms cost from 40 dollars, but I'd rather not spend more than 65 a night." — Maximum price?
"There are 12 branches and about 9,000 members in 400 teams." — Table: 400 ___
"You'll paint walls, but most of the time you'll be building bridges over streams." — Main activity: building ___
"There are no shops nearby, which some people don't like, but the best thing is that there's no traffic at all." — Advantage: a place without ___ (ONE WORD)
why: "At first ... but in the end" — tuzatishdan keyingi javob.
40 — eng past narx; savol eng ko'p to'lovni so'raydi.
400 raqamidan keyin kelgan ot — "teams". 9,000 — a'zolar soni, tuzoq.
"Most of the time" — asosiy faoliyat. "Walls" — qo'shimcha.
"Advantage" — afzallik: "the best thing" signal. Do'kon yo'qligi "some people don't like" — kamchilik, tuzoq.
class_ex.note: 5-gap SB Q10 ga tayyorgarlik: jadval ustuni (advantage) qaysi "without" kerakligini ko'rsatadi.

listenings.title: Student's Book, Track 19: Eco-holidays (Q1–6)
intro: Igor Petrov sayohat agentiga eko-sayohat haqida qo'ng'iroq qilgan edi, endi agentlikka kelgan. Agent avval uning talablarini yozib oladi.
Ko'rsatma: Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer. Savollar sahifasi quyida rasm sifatida (Exam advice ham shu yerda).

tasks.title: Questions 1–6 — Notes
tasks.type: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER
tasks.instr: Notes tartibi = suhbat tartibi. £ va "on plane" kabi berilgan so'zlarni takrorlamang.
why: "I originally planned to go for three weeks, but I think actually two would be better". Tuzoq: "a week, a month" (agent savoli) va "three weeks".
"I don't really want to go above £1,750". Raqam son bilan; £ notes'da bor.
"Each of them has a discount if you pay in advance". "Advance payments" = "pay in advance".
"One thing I'm keen on is having travel insurance while I'm away, so can you give me a quote?" Tuzoq: agent hozir narx ayta olmaydi (internet ishlamayapti), lekin so'ralgan narsa — sug'urta.
"I need to eat vegetarian meals when I fly". "On plane" = "when I fly"; tuzoq: "not a meat eater".
"I may need to see if you'll need a visa for some of the places". Millat (Russian) — bu savol uchun sabab, javob emas.
tasks.note: 1-savol — darsning asosiy tuzatish misoli. "Originally" so'zini eshitganda "keyingi gapni kut" signali deb o'rgating.
head: Notes
rows: Must check if he needs a

listenings.title: Student's Book, Track 20: Eco-holidays (Q7–10)
intro: Agent uchta variantni ko'rsatadi: Dumbarton Tablelands, Bago Nature Reserve, San Luis Island. Tinglashdan oldin ustunlarni o'qing: type of holiday / accommodation / advantage.
DIQQAT: bu guruhda chegara boshqa — Write ONE OR TWO WORDS for each answer. Raqam yo'q.

tasks.title: Questions 7–10 — Eco-holidays
tasks.type: ONE OR TWO WORDS
tasks.instr: Jadval qator bo'yicha eshitiladi. Tayyor kataklar ("close to nature", "village house", "hostel") — qayerda turganingizni bildiradi.
why: "Stay in a quite luxurious house or cabin built high up in a tree". Tuzoq: "luxurious", "cabin", "lovely countryside" — jadvalda "house in a ___" joyni so'raydi.
"You go and stay with a local family in their house". "Live with" = "stay with"; "village house" katagi shu gapdan.
"You help paint the local school and you get to meet the kids". Tuzoq: "hostel" — bu turar joy ustuni; "teaching" — lekin "working in a ___" joy so'raydi.
"There are no cars — you have to walk or use a bicycle". Tuzoq: "international tourism hasn't spoilt it yet" — turizm bor, faqat hali buzmagan.
tasks.note: 10-savolda "tourism" yozganlar ko'p bo'ladi. Ko'rsating: "without" = umuman yo'q; turizm esa bor, faqat "hasn't spoilt it yet".

accommodation

intro: Tekshiruvdan keyin ekranga chiqaring. Tuzatish ("originally ... actually") va har jadval qatoridagi "belgi" so'zlarni alohida rang bilan ko'rsating.

listenings.title: Workbook, Track 6: The Volunteer Agency (Q1–10)
listenings.qtype: Note completion + Table completion — imtihon rejimi
intro: Ryan tabiatni asrash loyihalarida ko'ngilli bo'lmoqchi; Hannah tashkilot loyihalarini tushuntiradi. Avval Workbook 1-mashqini bajaring.
Imtihondagidek: tayyorlanish, audio BIR MARTA. Chegaralar: Q1–6 — NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER; Q7–10 — ONE WORD.

tasks.title: 1-mashq: faqat raqam kerak bo'lgan savol
tasks.type: Tayyorlanish
tasks.instr: Q1–6 ni ko'zdan kechiring.
items: 1 Which questions might need a number only for the answer?
why: "has recruited ___ people" — faqat son. Jadvaldagi "300 ___" da raqam berilgan, bo'shliqqa so'z kerak (ONE WORD).

tasks.title: Questions 1–6 — The Volunteer Agency
tasks.type: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER
tasks.instr: Notes — Hannah'ning tashkilot haqidagi hikoyasi tartibida.
why: "At the moment we've got 130,000 volunteers working on these projects".
"Volunteers on that do diving or collect biodiversity data on tropical rainforest species". "Going into the rain forest" notes'da bor.
"A big project aimed at clearing up litter in rural areas". "In the countryside" = "in rural areas".
"Keeping the routes safe and attractive for cyclists". Ko'plik -s bilan.
"Within cities we also have the City Farms projects". Nom — bosh harf bilan.

"Many of our projects have very few, if any, paid staff". "Do not have any" = "very few, if any". Tuzoq: avval "salaried people" aytiladi, lekin u BOSHQA loyihalar haqida (u yerda maoshli xodimlar bor). Ikkalasi ham ikki so'z — hal qiluvchi narsa chegara emas, ma'no.

tasks.title: Questions 7–10 — Organisations
tasks.type: ONE WORD
tasks.instr: Faqat BITTA so'z. Jadvaldagi raqamlar (24,000; 300; 908) — qator "belgi"lari.
why: "Carrying out surveys of wildlife species". Tuzoq: "nature reserves", "community gardening" — boshqa faoliyat.
"There are over 300 groups and around 150,000 members of those groups". Jadvalda 300 — demak "groups".
"The organisation called Action Earth". "Earth" jadvalda bor.
"From planting trees to constructing fences and walls". "___ and walls" — fences. "Trees" — tuzoq.
tasks.note: 8-savol: 150,000 ni yozganlarga jadvalni ko'rsating — raqam allaqachon berilgan (300), kerakli so'z raqamdan keyin keladi.

listenings.title: Jony Academy: Green Weekend — volunteer registration (Q1–10)
intro: Dilnoza shahar "Green Weekend" tadbiriga guruhini ro'yxatdan o'tkazish uchun qo'ng'iroq qiladi. Ustoz skriptni BIR MARTA, tabiiy tezlikda o'qiydi (ikki rol).
Chegaralar: Q1–5 — NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER; Q6–10 — ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER. O'quvchilar tinglashdan oldin 40 soniya savollarni o'qiydi.
transcript: ORGANISER: Good morning, Green Weekend office. How can I help you?
DILNOZA: Hello. I'd like to register a group of volunteers for this weekend, please.
ORGANISER: Of course. Can I have your name?
DILNOZA: Yes, it's Dilnoza Karimova. That's K-A-R-I-M-O-V-A.
ORGANISER: K-A-R-I-M-O-V-A. Thank you. And how many people are in your group?
DILNOZA: Well, there were eight of us, but two of my friends have exams on Saturday, so it'll be six.

ORGANISER: Six, fine. Now, everyone meets on Saturday morning. Usually we meet at the main entrance of the park, but it's being repaired at the moment, so this time we're meeting in the car park next to the sports centre.
DILNOZA: Next to the sports centre. OK. Do we need to bring anything? Gloves?
ORGANISER: No, we provide gloves and rubbish bags for everyone. But please bring strong boots, because the river bank can be very muddy. And a water bottle, of course.
DILNOZA: Boots and a water bottle. And when do I need to confirm the names?
ORGANISER: Registration closes on Thursday. I know the website says Friday, but that's a mistake — we need the list a day earlier to order the equipment.
DILNOZA: Thursday, then. Could you tell me what activities there are?

ORGANISER: Sure. There are four. The biggest one is the river clean-up on the north bank. People expect to find leaves and branches, but most of what we pull out of the water is plastic — bottles, bags, that sort of thing.
DILNOZA: That's sad. What else?

ORGANISER: Then there's tree planting. That happens on the grass near the bridge — not the old footbridge, the new road bridge. Last year we planted two hundred trees, and our long-term aim is five hundred, but this weekend we've got 150 young trees ready.
DILNOZA: 150. My younger brother might like that. Is there anything for children?
ORGANISER: Yes, the bird box workshop in the community centre. It used to be for children over six, but the tools are quite sharp, so now it's only for children over eight.
DILNOZA: He's nine, so that's perfect. And the fourth activity?

ORGANISER: The litter survey in the town centre. Volunteers count and record the rubbish they find in each street, and all the results go to the local council, so they can decide where to put new bins.
DILNOZA: The council. Great. I think my group will choose the river.
ORGANISER: Wonderful. I'll email you a map this afternoon.

kahoot.q: In a Section 1 test, Questions 1–6 say 'NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER' and Questions 7–10 say 'ONE WORD ONLY'. What should you do?
options: Use the first limit for all
kahoot.explain: Har guruhning ko'rsatmasi alohida: ikkinchi guruhda birinchisining qoidasi bilan yozilsa, ball yo'qoladi.

kahoot.q: ONE WORD ONLY. Notes: 'Bring a waterproof ___'. You hear: 'Please bring a waterproof jacket.' What do you write?
kahoot.explain: "Waterproof" notes'da bor — faqat yetishmayotgan so'z yoziladi; ikki so'z ONE WORD chegarasidan oshadi.

kahoot.q: Notes: 'Deposit: £ ___'. You hear: 'a deposit of two hundred and forty pounds'. What do you write?
kahoot.explain: "Two hundred and forty" = 240; £ belgisi notes'da bor, shuning uchun faqat raqam yoziladi.

kahoot.q: You hear: 'fourteen thousand five hundred volunteers'. Which number do you write?
kahoot.explain: Fourteen thousand = 14,000, five hundred = 500; jami 14,500 — minglik vergul bilan yoziladi.

kahoot.q: 'We first planned the trip for Monday, but actually Wednesday suits us better.' Which day do you write?
kahoot.explain: "First ... but actually" — tuzatish signali; oxirgi, tasdiqlangan javob yoziladi.

kahoot.q: Table cell: '60 ___'. You hear: 'We have about 60 guides and 2,000 visitors a week.' What do you write?
kahoot.explain: 60 raqami jadvalda bor — undan keyin kelgan ot yoziladi; 2,000 boshqa narsaning (tashrifchilar) soni.

kahoot.q: In a Section 1 table completion task, how does the conversation usually move?
options: Row by row, in question order
Column by column, right to left
In a random order each time
From the last row to the first
kahoot.explain: Suhbat savollar tartibida boradi: gapiruvchi odatda bitta joy (qator) haqida hammasini aytadi, keyin keyingi qatorga o'tadi.

kahoot.q: Why should you read the cells that are already filled in (e.g. 'campsite') before you listen?
options: They help you follow the recording
They are the answers you must copy
They show the spelling of answers
They tell you each row's word limit
kahoot.explain: Tayyor kataklar "belgi" vazifasini bajaradi: ularni eshitsangiz, qaysi qatorda turganingizni bilasiz.

kahoot.q: ONE OR TWO WORDS. Table: 'volunteers build ___ for birds'. You hear: 'we build nest boxes for birds'. What do you write?
kahoot.explain: Audioda ko'plik (boxes) — -s tushib qolsa, javob xato; "for birds" jadvalda bor, takrorlanmaydi.

kahoot.q: 'Visitors expect the main problem to be noise, but in fact it's light from the hotels.' Main problem: ___
kahoot.explain: "Expect ... but in fact" — kutilgan narsa tuzoq, haqiqiy javob "in fact" dan keyin keladi.

kahoot.q: Notes: 'Free guided walk for ___ and their dogs'. What kind of word is most likely needed?
kahoot.explain: "For ___ and their dogs" — kimlar uchun? "Their" odamlarni ko'rsatadi, demak ko'plikdagi ot kerak (owners, families); yurish bepul — narx emas.

kahoot.q: The notes say 'costs nothing'. Which phrase in the recording means the same?
kahoot.explain: "Costs nothing" = "free"; arzon yoki yarim narx bo'lsa ham, baribir pul to'lanadi.

kahoot.q: Travel agent: 'I'll give you a quote for the car hire.' What is a 'quote' here?
options: the price they will charge you
a famous line from a book
a receipt for money you have paid
a list of rules for drivers
kahoot.explain: Quote — narx taklifi (smeta): kompaniya xizmat qancha turishini oldindan aytib beradi.

kahoot.q: Which phrase is closest in meaning to 'accommodation'?
kahoot.explain: Accommodation — turar joy: mehmonxona, hostel yoki oila uyi.

kahoot.q: Someone who works in 'wildlife conservation'…
options: hunts wild animals for their meat
catches wild animals to sell to zoos
kahoot.explain: Conservation — tabiatni muhofaza qilish: hayvonlarni va ular yashaydigan joyni asrash.

kahoot.q: A 'sustainable' holiday is one that…
options: does little harm to the environment
costs less than any other trip
lasts for a very long time
is only possible for very rich people
kahoot.explain: Sustainable — barqaror: tabiatga va mahalliy aholiga zarar yetkazmaydigan.

kahoot.q: An 'unspoilt' island is…
options: still natural and not built on
full of hotels, shops and tourists
kahoot.explain: Unspoilt — buzilmagan: tabiati asl holida, qurilish va turizm uni hali o'zgartirmagan.

kahoot.q: 'They booked the trip at short notice.' This means they booked it…
options: only a short time before leaving
several months before the departure date
kahoot.explain: At short notice — qisqa muddatda: jo'nashga oz vaqt qolganda.

kahoot.q: 'Bear in mind that the island has no shops.' Which verb is closest in meaning?
kahoot.explain: Bear in mind — yodda tutmoq, hisobga olmoq (= remember).

kahoot.q: If an activity is 'right up your street', it is…
options: exactly the kind of thing you like
on the road right outside your house
too difficult for you to try
kahoot.explain: Right up your street — aynan sizbop, didingizga mos (so'zma-so'z "ko'cha" ma'nosida emas).
